text.p: Following are the main stories in Wednesday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Acting prime minister Anwar Ibrahim said the strengthening of the family institution will form the best defence against crime.
-- Police seized apartments, cars, jewellery and cash totalling 1.5 million ringgit in the biggest seizure of assets amassed by the sale of drugs by an individual.
-- The Securities Commission has announced revisions in guidelines on the issue and offer of securities, and finetunes a number of exisiting rulings.
-- Acting PM Anwar has directed all Cabinet ministers to immediately stop public criticism of ministries which are not under them.

-- The government-promoted unit trust, Amanah Saham Wawasan 2020 (Vision 2020 Unit Trust) has drawn investments of 1.57 billion ringgit, or subscription rate of 52 percent since its August launching, said state investment firm Permodalan Nasional Bhd (PNB).
